events.verdict: Dinwiddie (DAL) is in a legal guarding position as he defends Ball (CHA) on the perimeter. He maintains a forearm against Ball's body during his shooting motion and the contact does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Ball (CHA) swipes down and avoids making contact with Gafford's (DAL) arm during his upwards shooting motion.
The ball is wedged between the rim and the backboard after Bridges' jump shot attempt and play resumes with a jump ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Williams (CHA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Irving's (DAL) pass goes off of Marshall (DAL) and out of bounds.
Washington (DAL) reaches in and the contact with Bridges' (CHA) forearm is marginal.
Washington (DAL) briefly has a hand on the ball, but Bridges (CHA) pulls it away and gains sole possession.
Washington (DAL) is out of bounds when he makes contact with the ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Washington (DAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Washington (DAL) reaches in makes illegal contact to Bridges' (CHA) wrist as he attempts to receive the pass.
Washington (DAL) commits a take foul on Ball (CHA).
Bridges (CHA) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Thompson's (DAL) arm.
Okogie (CHA) reaches for the rebound and the contact with Kleber's (DAL) arm is marginal.
Kleber (DAL) commits a take foul on Green (CHA).
